notes: 修复签名工具导入：去掉 LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace —— 之前是把我们沙盒里的 file URL 就地递过去，全能签/轻松签不认这个形态；现在 iOS 会复制一份到对方 Inbox。下载后弹窗显示本次文件名+大小，交付前校验文件存在/非空/.ipa
notesEn: Fixed signing-tool import: dropped LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace so iOS copies the IPA into the receiving app's Inbox instead of handing out an in-place file URL (which both ESign and UniversalSign reject). Post-download sheet now shows the exact file name/size and validates the file before delivery.
